source_en: Find the value of $ {a} + {b} $.
Add the digits in the same place.
When a place adds up to 10 or more, carry to the next place.
translation: የአንድ ቦታ ድምር 10 ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ከሆነ ወደ ቀጣዩ ቦታ ያዝ።

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} - {b} $.
Subtract the digits in the same place.
When you cannot subtract, borrow 10 from the next place.
Find the value of $ {a} \times {b} $.
Think of the times table or of equal groups.
translation: የማባዛት ሠንጠረዡን ወይም እኩል ቡድኖችን አስብ።

source_en: For bigger numbers, multiply place by place and add the parts.
translation: ለትልልቅ ቁጥሮች ቦታ በቦታ አባዛና ክፍሎቹን ደምር።

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} \div {b} $.
Use the times table of the divisor backwards.
Find what number times {b} gives {a}.
What is the digit in the tens place of ${n}$? (digits only)
translation: በ${n}$ ውስጥ የአስር ቦታ አሃዝ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: It is the second digit from the right.
Find the digit just to the left of the ones place.
translation: ከአንድ ቦታ በስተግራ ያለውን አሃዝ ፈልግ።

source_en: The tens digit of {n} is {ans}.
Find the rule and write the missing number: ${list}, \square$
Find the difference between neighbouring numbers.
translation: በጎረቤት ቁጥሮች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ፈልግ።

source_en: The numbers grow or shrink by the same amount each step.
translation: ቁጥሮቹ በእያንዳንዱ ደረጃ በተመሳሳይ መጠን ይጨምራሉ ወይም ይቀንሳሉ።

source_en: The difference between neighbours is {d}, so □={ans}.
translation: በጎረቤት ቁጥሮች መካከል ያለው ልዩነት {d} ነው፣ ስለዚህ □={ans}።

source_en: How many metres is {v} km? (digits only)
translation: {v} ኪ.ሜ ስንት ሜትር ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: 1 km is 1000 m.
Multiply {v} by 1000.
{v}×1000={ans}, so it is {ans} m.
How many millilitres is {v} L? (digits only)
translation: {v} ሊትር ስንት ሚሊሊትር ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: 1 L is 1000 mL.
Multiply {v} by 1000.
{v}×1000={ans}, so it is {ans} mL.
The radius of a circle is {r} cm. How many cm is its diameter? (cm)
translation: የአንድ ክብ ራዲየስ {r} ሴ.ሜ ነው። ዲያሜትሩ ስንት ሴ.ሜ ነው? (ሴ.ሜ)

source_en: The diameter is twice the radius.
Multiply the radius by 2.
{r}×2={ans}, so the diameter is {ans} cm.
Two angles of a triangle are {a}° and {b}°. How many degrees is the third angle? (degrees)
translation: የአንድ ሦስት ማዕዘን ሁለት ማዕዘኖች {a}° እና {b}° ናቸው። ሦስተኛው ማዕዘን ስንት ዲግሪ ነው? (ዲግሪ)

source_en: The three angles of a triangle add up to 180°.
translation: የሦስት ማዕዘን ሦስት ማዕዘኖች ድምር 180° ነው።

source_en: Subtract the two known angles from 180.
180-{a}-{b}={ans}, so it is {ans}°.
What number is made of {a} ten-thousands and {b} thousands? (digits only)
translation: {a} አስር ሺዎች እና {b} ሺዎች የያዘው ቁጥር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: {a} ten-thousands is {a}0000.
{b} thousands is {b}000. Add them.
{a} ten-thousands and {b} thousands make {ans}.
Find the value of $\frac{{a}}{{b}} + \frac{{c}}{{d}}$. (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: የ$\frac{{a}}{{b}} + \frac{{c}}{{d}}$ ዋጋ ፈልግ። (አስርዮሽ ቁጥር ወይም እንደ 3/4 ያለ ክፍልፋይ መጻፍ ይቻላል)

source_en: Rewrite the fractions with a common denominator.
Add the numerators.
$\frac{{a}}{{b}}+\frac{{c}}{{d}}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.
Find the value of $\frac{{a}}{{b}} \div {c}$. (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: የ$\frac{{a}}{{b}} \div {c}$ ዋጋ ፈልግ። (አስርዮሽ ቁጥር ወይም እንደ 3/4 ያለ ክፍልፋይ መጻፍ ይቻላል)

source_en: Dividing a fraction by a whole number multiplies its denominator by that number.
translation: ክፍልፋይን በሙሉ ቁጥር ማካፈል መለያውን በዚያ ቁጥር ያባዛል።

source_en: Simplify after you calculate.
$\frac{{a}}{{b}}\div{c}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.
Find the value of $ {a} \times {b} $.
Ignore the decimal point and multiply as whole numbers.
translation: የአስርዮሽ ነጥቡን ተው እና እንደ ሙሉ ቁጥሮች አባዛ።

source_en: Then put the decimal point back, with as many decimal places as the factors had.
translation: ከዚያ ነጥቡን መልስ፤ ከሁለቱ ቁጥሮች የአስርዮሽ ቦታዎች ድምር ጋር እኩል ቦታዎች ይኑሩት።

source_en: A rectangle is {w} cm wide and {h} cm tall. What is its area in cm²? (digits only)
translation: የአንድ ቀጥታ አራት ማዕዘን ስፋት {w} ሴ.ሜ እና ቁመቱ {h} ሴ.ሜ ነው። ስፋቱ (area) በሴ.ሜ² ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The area of a rectangle is width × height.
translation: የቀጥታ አራት ማዕዘን ስፋት = ወርድ × ቁመት።

source_en: Multiply the two side lengths.
{w}×{h}={ans}, so the area is {ans} cm².
A rectangle is {w} cm wide and {h} cm tall. How long is its perimeter in cm? (cm)
translation: የአንድ ቀጥታ አራት ማዕዘን ወርድ {w} ሴ.ሜ እና ቁመቱ {h} ሴ.ሜ ነው። ዙሪያው ስንት ሴ.ሜ ነው? (ሴ.ሜ)

source_en: The perimeter is the sum of the four sides.
You can use (width + height) × 2.
({w}+{h})×2={ans}, so the perimeter is {ans} cm.
Write $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ as a percentage. (digits only)
translation: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ን በመቶኛ ጻፍ። (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: A percentage is the ratio multiplied by 100.
You can also rewrite the fraction with denominator 100.
translation: ክፍልፋዩን መለያው 100 እንዲሆን አድርገህም መጻፍ ትችላለህ።

source_en: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}\times100={ans}$, so it is {ans}%.
In the proportion ${a} : {b} = \square : {d}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: በተመጣጣኝ ሬሾ ${a} : {b} = \square : {d}$ ውስጥ በሳጥኑ ውስጥ የሚገባው ቁጥር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: In a proportion, the product of the outer terms equals the product of the inner terms.
translation: በተመጣጣኝ ሬሾ የውጪዎቹ ብዜት ከውስጦቹ ብዜት ጋር እኩል ነው።

source_en: Solve □ × {b} = {a} × {d}.
Write this decimal as a percentage: ${d}$ (digits only)
translation: ይህን አስርዮሽ በመቶኛ ጻፍ: ${d}$ (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Multiply the decimal by 100 to get a percentage.
Move the decimal point two places to the right.
translation: የአስርዮሽ ነጥቡን ሁለት ቦታ ወደ ቀኝ አንቀሳቅስ።

source_en: {d}×100={ans}, so it is {ans}%.
One edge of a cube is {a} cm. What is its volume in cm³? (digits only)
translation: የአንድ ኩብ አንድ ጠርዝ {a} ሴ.ሜ ነው። መጠኑ (volume) በሴ.ሜ³ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The volume of a cube is edge × edge × edge.
Multiply {a} by itself three times.
{a}×{a}×{a}={ans}, so the volume is {ans} cm³.
A cuboid is {a} cm long, {b} cm wide and {c} cm high. What is its volume in cm³? (cm³)
translation: የአንድ ሳጥን (cuboid) ርዝመት {a} ሴ.ሜ፣ ወርድ {b} ሴ.ሜ እና ቁመት {c} ሴ.ሜ ነው። መጠኑ በሴ.ሜ³ ስንት ነው? (ሴ.ሜ³)

source_en: The volume of a cuboid is length × width × height.
Multiply all three lengths.
{a}×{b}×{c}={ans}, so the volume is {ans} cm³.
A circle has a radius of {r} cm. How long is its circumference in cm? (use $3.14$ for pi) (cm)
translation: የአንድ ክብ ራዲየስ {r} ሴ.ሜ ነው። ዙሪያው ስንት ሴ.ሜ ነው? (ለፓይ $3.14$ ተጠቀም) (ሴ.ሜ)

source_en: The circumference is diameter × pi.
The diameter is twice the radius.
{r}×2×3.14={ans}, so it is {ans} cm.
A circle has a radius of {r} cm. What is its area in cm²? (use $3.14$ for pi) (cm²)
translation: የአንድ ክብ ራዲየስ {r} ሴ.ሜ ነው። ስፋቱ በሴ.ሜ² ስንት ነው? (ለፓይ $3.14$ ተጠቀም) (ሴ.ሜ²)

source_en: The area is radius × radius × pi.
Square the radius, then multiply by 3.14.
{r}×{r}×3.14={ans}, so the area is {ans} cm².
The mean of {n} numbers is {m}. What is the sum of these {n} numbers? (digits only)
translation: የ{n} ቁጥሮች አማካይ {m} ነው። የእነዚህ {n} ቁጥሮች ድምር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: mean = sum ÷ count.
So sum = mean × count.
When $x={x}$, what is the value of ${expr}$?
Put the given number in place of x.
Multiply first, then add or subtract.
translation: መጀመሪያ አባዛ፣ ከዚያ ደምር ወይም ቀንስ።

source_en: Putting in x={x} gives ${expr}={ans}$.
Solve the linear equation ${eq}$ (find x).
Add or subtract the same number on both sides to leave the x term alone.
translation: የx ቃሉ ብቻውን እንዲቀር በሁለቱም ጎኖች ተመሳሳይ ቁጥር ደምር ወይም ቀንስ።

source_en: Then divide both sides by the number in front of x.
translation: ከዚያ ሁለቱንም ጎኖች በx ፊት ባለው ቁጥር አካፍል።

source_en: From ${eq}$ we get x={ans}.
In $x^{{a}} \times x^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: በ$x^{{a}} \times x^{{b}} = x^{\square}$ ውስጥ በሳጥኑ የሚገባው ቁጥር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: When the bases are equal, add the exponents.
Calculate {a}+{b}.
{a}+{b}={ans}, so □={ans}.
In $(x^{{a}})^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: በ$(x^{{a}})^{{b}} = x^{\square}$ ውስጥ በሳጥኑ የሚገባው ቁጥር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: A power of a power multiplies the exponents.
Calculate {a}×{b}.
{a}×{b}={ans}, so □={ans}.
What is the largest integer $x$ that satisfies $x+{a} < {b}$? (digits only)
translation: $x+{a} < {b}$ን የሚያሟላ ትልቁ ኢንቲጀር $x$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Subtract the same number from both sides to find the range of x.
translation: የx ክልል ለማግኘት ከሁለቱም ጎኖች ተመሳሳይ ቁጥር ቀንስ።

source_en: x must be less than the value you find; that value itself is not included.
translation: x ካገኘኸው ዋጋ ያነሰ መሆን አለበት፤ ዋጋው ራሱ አይካተትም።

source_en: x<{bound}, so the largest integer is {ans}.
What is the slope of the line through the points $({x1},\,{y1})$ and $({x2},\,{y2})$? (digits only)
translation: በ$({x1},\,{y1})$ እና $({x2},\,{y2})$ ነጥቦች የሚያልፈው መስመር ቁልቁለት (slope) ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The slope is (change in y) ÷ (change in x).
Divide the difference of the y-coordinates by the difference of the x-coordinates.
translation: የy መጋጠሚያዎችን ልዩነት በx መጋጠሚያዎች ልዩነት አካፍል።

source_en: How many outcomes are there when {n} coins are tossed together? (digits only)
translation: {n} ሳንቲሞች በአንድ ላይ ሲወረወሩ ስንት ውጤቶች ሊኖሩ ይችላሉ? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: One coin has 2 outcomes: heads or tails.
translation: አንድ ሳንቲም 2 ውጤቶች አሉት፦ ጭንቅላት ወይም ጅራት።

source_en: Multiply the number of outcomes of each coin.
2 multiplied {n} times is {ans}, so there are {ans} outcomes.
translation: 2ን {n} ጊዜ ማባዛት {ans} ነው፣ ስለዚህ {ans} ውጤቶች አሉ።

source_en: One base angle of an isosceles triangle is {b}°. How many degrees is the apex angle? (degrees)
translation: የአንድ ሁለት እኩል ጎኖች ሦስት ማዕዘን (isosceles) አንድ የመሠረት ማዕዘን {b}° ነው። የጫፉ ማዕዘን ስንት ዲግሪ ነው? (ዲግሪ)

source_en: The two base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal.
translation: የ isosceles ሦስት ማዕዘን ሁለቱ የመሠረት ማዕዘኖች እኩል ናቸው።

source_en: Subtract both base angles from 180°, the sum of the angles of a triangle.
translation: ከ180° (የሦስት ማዕዘን ማዕዘኖች ድምር) ሁለቱንም የመሠረት ማዕዘኖች ቀንስ።

source_en: 180-{b}×2={ans}, so the apex angle is {ans}°.
The two sides next to the right angle of a right triangle are {a} cm and {b} cm. How long is the longest side in cm? (cm)
translation: የቀኝ ማዕዘን ሦስት ማዕዘን ከቀኝ ማዕዘኑ አጠገብ ያሉት ሁለት ጎኖች {a} ሴ.ሜ እና {b} ሴ.ሜ ናቸው። ረጅሙ ጎን ስንት ሴ.ሜ ነው? (ሴ.ሜ)

source_en: Pythagorean theorem: (hypotenuse)² = (one side)² + (other side)².
Square both sides, add, then take the square root.
translation: ሁለቱንም ጎኖች በራሳቸው አባዛ፣ ደምር፣ ከዚያ ስኩዌር ሩትን ውሰድ።

source_en: ${a}^2+{b}^2={sq}$, so the longest side is {ans} cm.
What is the value of $\sqrt{{n}}$? (digits only)
translation: የ$\sqrt{{n}}$ ዋጋ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Find the positive number whose square is {n}.
Think of the times table.
${ans}^2={n}$, so $\sqrt{{n}}={ans}$.
If $({fa})({fb}) = x^2+px+q$, what is $p+q$? (digits only)
translation: $({fa})({fb}) = x^2+px+q$ ከሆነ $p+q$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Use $(x+a)(x+b)=x^2+(a+b)x+ab$.
p is the sum of the two numbers and q is their product.
translation: p የሁለቱ ቁጥሮች ድምር ሲሆን q ደግሞ ብዜታቸው ነው።

source_en: p={p} and q={q}, so p+q={ans}.
Which is the larger of the two roots of ${eq}$? (digits only)
translation: የ${eq}$ ሁለት ስሮች ትልቁ የትኛው ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Factorise the left-hand side.
The roots are the values of x that make a factor zero.
translation: ስሮቹ አንድን አካፋይ ዜሮ የሚያደርጉ የx ዋጋዎች ናቸው።

source_en: From ${fact}$ the roots are {roots}, so the larger root is {ans}.
translation: ከ${fact}$ ስሮቹ {roots} ናቸው፣ ስለዚህ ትልቁ ስር {ans} ነው።

source_en: The vertex of the quadratic function $y={expr}$ is $(p,\ q)$. What is $p+q$? (digits only)
translation: የquadratic ተግባር $y={expr}$ ጫፍ (vertex) $(p,\ q)$ ነው። $p+q$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: In $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ the vertex is $(p,\ q)$.
Watch the sign inside the brackets.
The vertex is $({p},\ {q})$, so p+q={ans}.
What is the remainder when $P(x)={poly}$ is divided by ${div}$? (digits only)
translation: $P(x)={poly}$ በ${div}$ ሲካፈል ቀሪው ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Remainder theorem: the remainder of P(x) divided by x-a is P(a).
translation: የቀሪ ቲዎሬም፦ P(x) በx-a ሲካፈል ቀሪው P(a) ነው።

source_en: Put a in place of x and calculate.
By the remainder theorem, P({a})={ans}.
What is the sum of the real part and the imaginary part of ${expr}$? (digits only)
translation: የ${expr}$ እውነተኛ ክፍል (real part) እና ምናባዊ ክፍል (imaginary part) ድምር ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Add the real parts together and the imaginary parts together.
translation: እውነተኛዎቹን ክፍሎች ከእውነተኛዎቹ፣ ምናባዊዎቹን ከምናባዊዎቹ ጋር ደምር።

source_en: Treat i like a letter.
The real part is {re} and the imaginary part is {im}, so the sum is {ans}.
translation: እውነተኛው ክፍል {re} እና ምናባዊው ክፍል {im} ነው፣ ስለዚህ ድምሩ {ans} ነው።

source_en: In how many ways can you choose {r} of {n} different people and line them up? (digits only)
translation: ከ{n} የተለያዩ ሰዎች {r}ን መርጦ በመስመር ማስቀመጥ በስንት መንገዶች ይቻላል? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Order matters, so this is a permutation.
translation: ቅደም ተከተል ይቆጠራል፣ ስለዚህ ይህ permutation ነው።

source_en: Start at {n} and multiply {r} numbers, counting down.
translation: ከ{n} ጀምረህ ወደ ታች እየቆጠርክ {r} ቁጥሮችን አባዛ።

source_en: {calc}={ans}, so there are {ans} ways.
In how many ways can you choose {r} of {n} different people when order does not matter? (digits only)
translation: ቅደም ተከተል የማይቆጠር ከሆነ ከ{n} የተለያዩ ሰዎች {r}ን በስንት መንገዶች መምረጥ ይቻላል? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Order does not matter, so this is a combination.
translation: ቅደም ተከተል አይቆጠርም፣ ስለዚህ ይህ combination ነው።

source_en: Divide the number of permutations by {r}!.
{calc}={ans}, so there are {ans} ways.
What is the distance between the points A({x1}, {y1}) and B({x2}, {y2})? (digits only)
translation: በA({x1}, {y1}) እና B({x2}, {y2}) ነጥቦች መካከል ያለው ርቀት ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The distance is $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$.
Square the difference of the x-coordinates and of the y-coordinates, then add.
translation: የx መጋጠሚያዎችን ልዩነት እና የy መጋጠሚያዎችን ልዩነት በራሳቸው አባዛና ደምር።

source_en: What is the radius of the circle $({fx})^2+({fy})^2={r2}$? (digits only)
translation: የክቡ $({fx})^2+({fy})^2={r2}$ ራዲየስ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: In $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, r is the radius.
The number on the right is r².
translation: በቀኝ በኩል ያለው ቁጥር r² ነው።

source_en: $r^2={r2}$, so the radius is {ans}.
How many integers $x$ satisfy the quadratic inequality ${eq}<0$? (digits only)
translation: quadratic እኩልነትን ${eq}<0$ የሚያሟሉ ስንት ኢንቲጀሮች $x$ አሉ? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Factorise the left-hand side to find the two roots.
translation: ሁለቱን ስሮች ለማግኘት የግራውን ጎን በአካፋዮች ክፈል።

source_en: Count the integers between the roots; the roots themselves are not included.
translation: በስሮቹ መካከል ያሉትን ኢንቲጀሮች ቁጠር፤ ስሮቹ ራሳቸው አይካተቱም።

source_en: From ${fact}<0$ we get {r1}<x<{r2}, so there are {ans} integers.
What is the value of $\log_{{b}} {n}$? (digits only)
translation: የ$\log_{{b}} {n}$ ዋጋ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: $\log_b n=k$ means $b^k=n$.
Count how many times you multiply {b} to get {n}.
translation: {n} ለማግኘት {b}ን ስንት ጊዜ ማባዛት እንዳለብህ ቁጠር።

source_en: ${b}^{{ans}}={n}$, so the answer is {ans}.
Write $\theta=\dfrac{{num}}{{d}}$ (radians) in degrees. (digits only)
translation: $\theta=\dfrac{{num}}{{d}}$ (ራዲያን) ን በዲግሪ ጻፍ። (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: $\pi$ radians is 180°.
Put 180° in place of $\pi$.
Putting in $\pi=180^\circ$ gives {ans}°.
What is term number {n} of the arithmetic sequence with first term {a} and common difference {d}? (digits only)
translation: የመጀመሪያው ቃል {a} እና የጋራ ልዩነቱ {d} የሆነ arithmetic ቅደም ተከተል {n}ኛ ቃል ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The general term is $a_n=a+(n-1)d$.
Multiply (n-1) by the common difference and add it to the first term.
translation: (n-1)ን በጋራ ልዩነቱ አባዛና ከመጀመሪያው ቃል ጋር ደምር።

source_en: What is term number {n} of the geometric sequence with first term {a} and common ratio {r}? (digits only)
translation: የመጀመሪያው ቃል {a} እና የጋራ ሬሾው {r} የሆነ geometric ቅደም ተከተል {n}ኛ ቃል ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The general term is $a_n=ar^{n-1}$.
Multiply by the common ratio (n-1) times.
{a} times {r} to the power ({n}-1) is {ans}.
What is the value of $\lim_{x\to {a}}({f})$? (digits only)
translation: የ$\lim_{x\to {a}}({f})$ ዋጋ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: For a polynomial, the limit equals the value of the function.
translation: ለpolynomial ገደቡ (limit) ከተግባሩ ዋጋ ጋር እኩል ነው።

source_en: Put {a} in place of x.
Putting in x={a} gives {ans}.
If $f(x)={poly}$, what is $f'({a})$? (digits only)
translation: $f(x)={poly}$ ከሆነ $f'({a})$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Find the derivative, then put {a} in place of x.
translation: ተወላጁን (derivative) ፈልግ፣ ከዚያ በx ቦታ {a} አስገባ።

source_en: $f'(x)={deriv}$, so $f'({a})={ans}$.
What is the value of $\int_{0}^{{b}} ({fx})\,dx$? (digits only)
translation: የ$\int_{0}^{{b}} ({fx})\,dx$ ዋጋ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Find the antiderivative, then calculate (value at the upper limit) - (value at the lower limit).
translation: antiderivative ፈልግ፣ ከዚያ (በላይኛው ወሰን ዋጋ) - (በታችኛው ወሰን ዋጋ) ስላ።

source_en: $\int x\,dx=\frac{x^2}{2}$ and $\int c\,dx=cx$.
Putting x={b} into the antiderivative ${anti}$ gives {ans}.
What is the area enclosed by the curve $y={k}x^2$, the $x$-axis and the line $x={a}$? (digits only)
translation: በ$y={k}x^2$ ኩርባ፣ በ$x$-ዘንግ እና በ$x={a}$ መስመር የተከበበው ስፋት ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The area is the definite integral from 0 to {a}.
translation: ስፋቱ ከ0 እስከ {a} ያለው definite integral ነው።

source_en: What is the sum of the infinite geometric series with first term {a} and common ratio ${rtex}$? (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: የመጀመሪያው ቃል {a} እና የጋራ ሬሾው ${rtex}$ የሆነ ማለቂያ የሌለው geometric ተከታታይ ድምር ስንት ነው? (አስርዮሽ ቁጥር ወይም እንደ 3/4 ያለ ክፍልፋይ መጻፍ ይቻላል)

source_en: The sum exists when the absolute value of the ratio is less than 1.
translation: የሬሾው ፍጹም ዋጋ ከ1 ያነሰ ሲሆን ድምሩ አለ።

source_en: The sum is (first term) ÷ (1 - ratio).
If the random variable $X$ follows the binomial distribution $B({n},\ {p})$, what is $E(X)$? (digits only)
translation: ራንደም ተለዋዋጭ $X$ የbinomial ስርጭት $B({n},\ {p})$ ከተከተለ $E(X)$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The mean of $B(n,\ p)$ is $np$.
Multiply n and p.
What is the magnitude $|\vec{a}|$ of the vector $\vec{a}=({x},\ {y})$? (digits only)
translation: የvector $\vec{a}=({x},\ {y})$ መጠን $|\vec{a}|$ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: Square each component, add, then take the square root.
translation: እያንዳንዱን ክፍል በራሱ አባዛ፣ ደምር፣ ከዚያ ስኩዌር ሩት ውሰድ።

source_en: What is the $x$-coordinate of the focus of the parabola $y^2={c}x$? (digits only)
translation: የparabola $y^2={c}x$ ፎከስ $x$-መጋጠሚያ ስንት ነው? (ቁጥሮችን በ0-9 አሃዞች ብቻ ይጻፉ)

source_en: The focus of $y^2=4px$ is $(p,\ 0)$.
Find p from {c}=4p.
4p={c}, so p={ans}.
For events $A,\ B$, $P(A)={pa}$ and $P(A\cap B)={pab}$. What is $P(B\mid A)$? (write a decimal)
translation: ለክስተቶች $A,\ B$ ፣ $P(A)={pa}$ እና $P(A\cap B)={pab}$ ነው። $P(B\mid A)$ ስንት ነው? (አስርዮሽ ጻፍ)

source_en: Conditional probability: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$.
Divide the two values.
{pab}÷{pa}={ans}.
Which is the biggest of {list}? (digits only)
translation: ከ{list} ውስጥ ትልቁ የቱ ነው? (አሃዝ ብቻ)

source_en: Compare the numbers one by one.
Find the number that stands for the most.
translation: ከሁሉ የበለጠ መጠን የሚወክለውን ቁጥር ፈልግ።

source_en: The biggest of {list} is {ans}.
Which is the smallest of {list}? (digits only)
translation: ከ{list} ውስጥ ትንሹ የቱ ነው? (አሃዝ ብቻ)

source_en: Compare the numbers one by one.
Find the number that stands for the least.
translation: ከሁሉ ያነሰ መጠን የሚወክለውን ቁጥር ፈልግ።

source_en: It is the third digit from the right.
In a three-digit number it is the first digit.
translation: ባለ ሦስት አሃዝ ቁጥር ውስጥ የመጀመሪያው አሃዝ ነው።

source_en: It is the same as skip-counting up by {k}.
translation: በ{k} ወደ ላይ እየዘለሉ እንደመቁጠር ነው።

translation: ከ{n} በ{k} የሚያንሰው ቁጥር ስንት ነው? (አሃዝ ብቻ)

source_en: It is the same as skip-counting down by {k}.
translation: በ{k} ወደ ታች እየዘለሉ እንደመቁጠር ነው።

source_en: Only the digit in one place changes.

source_en: The four angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°.
translation: የአራት ማዕዘን አራቱ ማዕዘኖች ድምር 360° ነው።

translation: ሦስቱን የታወቁ ማዕዘኖች ከ360 ላይ ቀንስ።

source_en: Or divide the numerator by the denominator.
translation: ወይም የላይኛውን ቁጥር በታችኛው ቁጥር ክፈል።

p is 2a and q is a².

source_en: Find two numbers whose sum is the coefficient of x and whose product is the constant term.
translation: ድምራቸው የx ኮፊሸንት ሆኖ ብዜታቸው ቋሚውን ቁጥር የሚሆኑ ሁለት ቁጥሮችን ፈልግ።

source_en: After finding them, subtract the smaller from the bigger.
translation: ካገኘሃቸው በኋላ ትንሹን ከትልቁ ላይ ቀንስ።

translation: ${poly}=({fm})({fn})$ ስለሆነ ሁለቱ ቁጥሮች {m} እና {n} ናቸው፣ ልዩነታቸውም {ans} ነው።

translation: የኳድራቲክ እኩልታ ${eq}=0$ discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ ዋጋ ስንት ነው? (አሃዝ ብቻ)

Watch the signs of a, b and c.
translation: የa፣ b እና c ምልክቶችን ተጠንቀቅ።

What is the sum of the first {n} terms of the arithmetic sequence with first term {a} and common difference {d}? (digits only)
translation: የመጀመሪያው ቃል {a} እና የጋራ ልዩነቱ {d} የሆነ arithmetic sequence የመጀመሪያ {n} ቃላት ድምር ስንት ነው? (አሃዝ ብቻ)

source_en: The sum formula is $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$.
You can also find the last term and calculate (first + last) × number of terms ÷ 2.
translation: የመጨረሻውን ቃል አግኝተህ (የመጀመሪያ + የመጨረሻ) × የቃላት ብዛት ÷ 2 ማስላትም ትችላለህ።

source_en: A geometric sequence has first term {a} and third term {c}. What is the common ratio? (positive, digits only)
translation: የgeometric sequence የመጀመሪያ ቃል {a} ሲሆን ሦስተኛው ቃል {c} ነው። የጋራ ሬሽዮው ስንት ነው? (አዎንታዊ፣ አሃዝ ብቻ)

source_en: The third term is the first term multiplied by the ratio twice.
translation: ሦስተኛው ቃል የመጀመሪያው ቃል በሬሽዮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሲባዛ ነው።

source_en: From $ar^2=c$ find $r^2$.
From {a}×r²={c} we get r²={sq}, so the common ratio is {ans}.
translation: ከ{a}×r²={c} r²={sq} ስለሚሆን የጋራ ሬሽዮው {ans} ነው።

translation: ቀንስ፣ ከዚያ በx ቦታ የlimit ዋጋውን ተካ።

source_en: After factorising the numerator and cancelling, putting in x={a} gives {ans}.
translation: አሃዛዊውን ተንትኖ ከቀነሱ በኋላ x={a} ሲተካ {ans} ይሆናል።
